 }
diff --git a/lib/discount.mjs b/lib/discount.mjs

 export function applyDiscount(total, percent) {
-  return total - percent
+  return total - (total * percent) / 100
 }

artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass now.

The bug spanned two modules:

- `lib/cart.mjs` — `cartTotal` summed only `item.price` and ignored quantity. It now uses `item.price * item.qty` per line (consistent with `lineTotal`).
- `lib/discount.mjs` — `applyDiscount` subtracted the percent as an absolute amount. It now computes `total - (total * percent) / 100`, so 10% off 200 = 180.

`lib/pricing.mjs` was already correct, so no change was needed there.
